channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
item.description: Fanatics and OpenAI launched an AI-powered Shop the Look that recommends complete game-day outfits, with testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products showing 10% higher engagement and an initial 50-product test completed in under 24 hours. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering
item.description: Anthropic filed a Form S-1 with the SEC for a Class A common stock IPO on Nasdaq Global Select under ticker ANT, with share count and price range undetermined and Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley handling the preliminary prospectus.

item.title: ANTHROPIC 🔥: S-1 IPO filing is set for 9AM EST today as reported by Bloomberg!
item.description: Anthropic is set to publicly file its S-1 IPO at 9AM EST Monday, Bloomberg reports, with a roadshow possibly starting the week of Nov 9 and an offering size expected to match or exceed SpaceX's.

item.title: If you were thinking concentrating AI behind closed doors is safe, it is time to update your priors!
item.description: A Washington Post report cited by Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue says former DOGE researchers used AI agents to infiltrate Anthropic’s systems, including a Slack channel discussing its most sensitive models, in under 12 hours.

item.title: Meta announces financing plan of up to $95 billion to fund AI and other businesses
item.description: Meta seeks up to $95 billion via $22.5 billion Class A forward sales, $12.5 billion mandatory convertible preferred and up to $60 billion at-the-market Class C shares, funding AI and core business as 2026 capex is projected at $135–145 billion.

item.title: Check out the creator guides in the comments to get more out of #Kling4. #KlingAI
item.description: Kling 4.0's day-one Runware API release delivers up to 30-second 1080p native-audio video, multi-keyframe control, 15 inputs per request and $0.133-per-second pricing, while the post directs users to comment-section creator guides.

item.title: Gartner survey: 44% of CEOs can't tell whether AI is actually making money
item.description: Gartner survey: 44% of CEOs can't tell whether AI is actually making money (AIbase)

item.title: 何夕2077 AI 深度信号周报 2026 W43：把关权易主与千亿算力
item.description: In Anthropic's auto-mode test, 1,053 users blocked only 13.6% while AI blocked 89%, and the weekly roundup ties that gatekeeping shift to DeepSeek's roughly 100 billion yuan raise and 1GW Ascend compute. (Daily Digest)

item.title: Kazik gives a step-by-step demo of reverse-engineering and modifying real hardware with Codex and Claude
item.description: Digital Life Kazike shares a hands-on tutorial on using AI to reverse-engineer and retrofit real-world devices, using his company's four meeting-room TVs as the example: he used Codex to enable ADB debugging and connect to the TVs, stripped out boot ads, rebuilt a clean home screen and a particle-based dynamic screensaver, then replicated the setup across the other three.

item.title: Reddit's r/opensource community bans AI projects, prompting developers to set up their own
item.description: After Reddit’s r/opensource banned AI projects, developers refused to compromise and built a new community, a split that captures open source’s disagreement over how to treat AI. (AIbase)

item.title: Samsung Electronics says AI cuts new semiconductor materials R&D cycle from 5 years to 2 years
item.description: Samsung Electronics says AI cuts new semiconductor materials R&D cycle from 5 years to 2 years (AIbase)

item.title: Chinese AI takes the top five spots in global usage rankings, with weekly call volume beating the US for 26 consecutive weeks
item.description: Chinese AI takes the top five spots in global usage rankings, with weekly call volume beating the US for 26 consecutive weeks (AIbase)

item.title: Global weekly LLM API volume tops 188 trillion: Chinese AI models sweep the top five, with DeepSeek's new model surging to No. 1
item.description: Global weekly large-model call volume has passed 188 trillion, with Chinese AI models sweeping the top five spots and DeepSeek's newest model claiming the number-one ranking. (AIbase)

item.title: ByteDance responds: Seed core lead Zhou Chang has not left the company
item.description: ByteDance's response that Seed core lead Zhou Chang has not departed is all the page delivers, as the body returns a 404 notice saying the article does not exist or has been deleted, with no further details. (AIbase)

item.title: AI Bridge — Every AI coding agent on your Mac, in its place
item.description: AI Bridge's page promises to put every AI coding agent on a Mac in its place, but the site returns only a CAPTCHA security check, so no product details are readable. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Nvidia open-sources Flora, a robotics data engine that cuts annotation costs 125x compared with GPT-6Astra
item.description: Nvidia has open-sourced Flora, a robotics data engine it says cuts annotation costs 125-fold versus GPT-6Astra, with details on its robot data labeling approach and the scale of the savings. (AIbase)

item.title: PaperPilot: a zero-cloud, pure-Rust PDF engine built on WASM and MCP
item.description: PaperPilot: a zero-cloud, pure-Rust PDF engine built on WASM and MCP (github.com)

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic have slashed large language model (LLM) prices by as much as 80% in just a few months. Why?
item.description: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna's input price 80% to $0.20 per MTok and Fable 5.1's cache-read cost 75%, as the piece examines why cache reads covering 96%-99% of agent coding token spend drive LLM pricing. (minimaxir.com)

item.title: Fixing Tool-Call Accuracy in vLLM
item.description: With vLLM 0.28, serving Kimi K2.6 yielded only 92% tool-call schema accuracy, failing 2 of 25 calls, while vLLM 0.31's constrained decoding claims 100% schema adherence for newer Kimi and DeepSeek models.

item.title: AI restores mosaic-blurred QR codes in minutes, and a hands-on test exposes the 'fake mosaic' trap
item.description: A demonstration shows AI recovering a mosaicked QR code in just minutes, exposing the “fake mosaic” trap: information that looks obscured can still be reconstructed, so blurring alone is not a reliable way to hide data. (AIbase)
